# Spake2 v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

SPAKE2 password-authenticated key exchange over Ed25519 (BoringSSL-compatible)

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://spake2.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Spake2](https://spake2.hexdocs.pm/Spake2.md): 
- [Spake2.Ed25519](https://spake2.hexdocs.pm/Spake2.Ed25519.md): Ed25519 twisted Edwards curve point arithmetic for SPAKE2.
- [Spake2.HKDF](https://spake2.hexdocs.pm/Spake2.HKDF.md): HKDF (HMAC-based Key Derivation Function) per RFC 5869.

- Exceptions
  - [Spake2.Ed25519.DecodeError](https://spake2.hexdocs.pm/Spake2.Ed25519.DecodeError.md): Raised when an Ed25519 point cannot be decoded.
